defaults.video_script: In June 2022, Georgina gave birth to twins. Their baby son didn't survive the birth. Their daughter did. Ronaldo named her Bella Esmeralda, and later said she became his reason to keep getting out of bed during the darkest months of his career. He's described holding her for the first time as the moment grief and love collided. Years later, he still posts her laughing in his arms, like nothing was ever lost.

videos.video_subject: After Mbappé, Haaland and Kane broke Messi Champions League records, Ronaldo's 68 goals after turning 30 remains far ahead of Kane's 36 and Messi's 35
videos.video_script: Everyone is breaking Messi's records. Mbappé, Haaland and Kane did it in two nights. But one record is still out of reach. After turning thirty, Ronaldo scored sixty-eight Champions League goals. Kane has thirty-six. Messi has thirty-five. The new generation is chasing, but they are nowhere close. Can anyone ever catch him?
